description: Source code for 'seama.c', a C program that handles creating, verifying, sealing, and extracting 'seama' image files, including checksum calculations and meta data management.

methods.name: verbose
methods.description: Prints formatted verbose output if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: cleanup_exit
methods.description: Prints exit message and terminates the program with given exit code.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set program options.

methods.name: calculate_digest
methods.description: Calculates MD5 digest of a file segment.

methods.name: copy_file
methods.description: Copies data from one file to another.

methods.name: verify_seama
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and checksum of a seama file.

methods.name: write_seama_header
methods.description: Writes a seama file header with meta data and size.

methods.name: write_checksum
methods.description: Writes checksum data to a file.

methods.name: write_meta_data
methods.description: Writes meta data entries to a seama file.

methods.name: dump_seama
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about a seama file.

methods.name: seal_files
methods.description: Seals multiple image files into a single seama file.

methods.name: pack_files
methods.description: Creates individual seama files from input images, including checksum and meta data.

methods.name: match_meta
methods.description: Checks if meta data matches specified criteria.

methods.name: extract_file
methods.description: Extracts an image from a seama file based on meta data.
